primitives.name: Drop Rate vs Contested Catch Rate
primitives.verbatim_quote: ## @acccountstat (Stat Acccount, 13.9K followers) - Recurring: Drop Rate vs Contested Catch Rate; Top 10 CBs by Yards/Coverage Snap; RB Elusiveness; WR Receiving Efficiency; Yards x EPA; QB Pass Accuracy.
primitives.latex: DroppingRate = \frac{Total Drops}{Targeted Passes} \quad ContestedCatchRate = \frac{Contested Catch Attempts}{Contested Targets}
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'DroppingRate': 'dimensionless percentage', 'ContestedCatchRate': 'dimensionless percentage', 'Total Drops': 'count', 'Targeted Passes': 'count', 'Contested Catch Attempts': 'count', 'Contested Targets': 'count'}
primitives.assumptions: Assumes perfect passive tracking data for drops and contested throws. No adjustment for receiver skill or defender quality.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Breaks down when small sample sizes cause extreme values (e.g., zero denominator).

layer2.mapping: Dual to NFL Next Gen Stats 'Catch Probability' (Bayesian posterior) and 'Yards After Catch' (conformal prediction).
layer2.telemetry: Observed contest rate from tracking data vs. official NFL contest flags

primitives.name: xFP (Expected Fantasy Points)
primitives.verbatim_quote: ## @scottbarrettdfb (Scott Barrett, 116.9K followers) - xFP (popularized at PFF 2017): fantasypointsdata.com describes it as "XFP from a model over the play's own context, recombined through whichever scoring system you pick." Exact model undisclosed.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'xFP': 'fantasy points', 'w_i': 'weight for opportunity type i (carry, target, etc.)', 'f(X_i, \\theta)': 'contextual scoring function parameterized by \\theta', '\\epsilon': 'model error term'}
primitives.assumptions: Linear combination of weighted opportunity types. Model parameters \theta are estimated from historical fantasy outcomes.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Collapses when underlying scoring system changes drastically (e.g., half-point PPR adoption).

layer2.mapping: Derived from NFL Next Gen Stats 'Value Over Average' (VOA) framework, adapted to fantasy scoring distributions.
layer2.telemetry: Actual fantasy points vs. predicted xFP residuals (for anomaly detection)

primitives.name: Depth-Adjusted Yards per Target
primitives.verbatim_quote: - **Depth-adjusted YPT over expectation (verbatim):** "Expected Yards per Target (based on depth of target on each individual target) vs.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'YPT_{adj}': 'yards per target', 'Yards_j': 'actual yards gained on target j', 'E[Yards|Depth_j)': 'expected yards given target depth j (from regression)', 'TargetCount_j': 'number of targets at depth j'}
primitives.assumptions: Uses linear regression of yards on depth to compute expectations. Assumes constant variance across depths.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Breaks down for deep passes due to sparse data and non-linear distance effects.

layer2.mapping: Isomorphic to GSI's "Target Expected Value" (TEV) operator, which uses logistic regression on target location.
layer2.telemetry: Residual yards after controlling for target depth (OLS diagnostics)
